descriptions.archery-world-tour.html: Aim at targets, adjust for distance, and compete in precision archery rounds in Archery World Tour.
descriptions.battledudes.html: Move through 2D maps, use weapons and vehicles, and battle other players in the multiplayer shooter Battle Dudes.
descriptions.bottle-flip.html: Flick a bottle, control its rotation, and try to land it upright across a series of bottle-flipping challenges.
descriptions.box-tower.html: Drop blocks at the right moment and stack a tower as high as you can in Box Tower.
descriptions.car-rush.html: Drive along a busy highway, steer around traffic, and keep moving through each stage of Car Rush.
descriptions.car-stunts.html: Drive across stunt tracks, take jumps, and steer through obstacles in the 3D driving game City Stunts.
descriptions.cleaning-game.html: Tidy rooms, pick up clutter, and complete household cleaning tasks in Home Cleaning Game.
descriptions.color-line.html: Guide a moving color line through narrow paths, avoid obstacles, and stay on course in Color Line.
descriptions.cut-the-rope.html: Cut ropes in the right order to drop candy to Om Nom, collect stars, and solve physics puzzles in Cut the Rope.
descriptions.fire-truck-simulator.html: Drive a fire truck through city streets and complete emergency-response missions in Fire Truck Simulator.
descriptions.fireboyandwatergirl.html: Guide Fireboy and Watergirl through cooperative platform puzzles, using each character's abilities to reach the exits.
descriptions.flappy-ball.html: Tap to keep the ball in the air, pass between obstacles, and beat your best score in this Flappy-style arcade game.
descriptions.flappy-dunk.html: Tap to guide a bouncing basketball through hoops and build a scoring streak in Flappy Dunk.
descriptions.greyhound-racing.html: Choose a greyhound and race it around the track, timing each run to finish ahead of the competition.
descriptions.happy-glass.html: Draw lines to guide water into an empty glass and solve each physics puzzle in Happy Glass.
descriptions.hole-io.html: Move a growing hole around the city, swallow objects, and compete to absorb more than other players in Hole.io.
descriptions.killer-assassin.html: Move between cover, avoid enemy sight lines, and take out targets to clear each stage in Killer Assassin.
descriptions.magic-piano-tiles.html: Tap the piano tiles in time with the music and avoid missing notes as songs become more demanding.
descriptions.moto-road-rash.html: Ride a motorcycle through highway traffic, avoid collisions, and cover as much road as possible in Moto Road Rash 3D.
descriptions.pacman.html: Guide Pac-Man through mazes, collect dots, and avoid ghosts as you clear each board in Pacman Classic.
descriptions.rocket-goal-io.html: Drive a rocket-powered car around the arena, hit the ball, and score goals in Rocket Goal.io.
descriptions.running-fred.html: Run through dangerous levels, dodge traps, and react quickly to keep Fred alive in Running Fred.
descriptions.spidey-rescue.html: Swing between platforms, avoid hazards, and complete rescue challenges in Spidey Rescue.
descriptions.square-bird.html: Tap to build blocks under your bird, clear obstacles, and keep moving through levels in Square Bird.
descriptions.squid-challenge.html: Take on a series of survival challenges, follow each round's rules, and avoid elimination in Squid Challenge.
descriptions.stock-car-hero.html: Race stock cars around fast circuits, overtake the field, and aim for a podium finish in Stock Car Hero.
descriptions.subway-surfers.html: Sprint along the railway, dodge trains and barriers, and collect coins while escaping the inspector in Subway Surfers.
descriptions.table-tennis-world-tour.html: Serve, return, and rally against opponents in a table-tennis tournament in Table Tennis World Tour.
descriptions.temple-run.html: Run through ancient ruins, turn around obstacles, and collect coins while escaping the pursuing creature in Temple Run.
descriptions.tic-tac-toe-extreme.html: Play Tic Tac Toe Extreme in quick matches against another player or the computer in this browser-based noughts-and-crosses game.
descriptions.under-the-red-sky.html: Jump across platforms and avoid hazards as you make your way through the parkour adventure Under the Red Sky.
descriptions.worms-zone.html: Guide a worm around the arena, collect food to grow, and avoid crashing into other players in Worms Zone.
